_what: Prior art for FUSION-BREAKPOINT-directed immunotherapy found by the FIRST EVER run of the fusion-breakpoint watch row added to scripts/method-watch.mjs on 2026-08-24. Records copied verbatim from a committed fetch product.
_why_this_file_exists: The watch row was added the same day because no existing row could match a fusion-breakpoint THERAPEUTIC paper (the only FET row required a MODEL word). Adding the row closed the hole going forward; this artifact is what came out of looking BACKWARD through it. It anchors every identifier so no session types a PMID or DOI from recollection (CLAUDE.md section 7) and lint_citations.py can trace each one.

_provenance.produced_by: GitHub Actions run 32734223516, workflow fetch-literature.yml on ref main, Europe PMC query = the new watch row's query widened to sibling fusion sarcomas (SYT-SSX, SS18-SSX, PAX3-FOXO1, DSRCT).
_provenance.how: git fetch origin literature-cache --depth=1; git show origin/literature-cache:<source_path>. The dev sandbox has no outbound network; nothing here was retrieved or typed by hand.
